How Analysts Feel About Apple Inc. (AAPL) After Reaching Record High? June 4, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson

The stock of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) reached all time high today, Jun, 4 and still has $199.50 target or 4.00 % above today’s $191.83 share price. This indicates more upside for the $942.87 billion company. This technical setup was reported by Barchart.com . If the $199.50 PT is reached, the company will be worth $37.71 billion more.
Trading stocks at an all time highs is usually a winning strategy. An all time high points to a stock which has the most positive fundamentals ever. Even thought the pullback rate is high, if correct risk management is utilized, investors can trade very well such events.
The stock increased 0.84% or $1.59 $191.83. About 24.84 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 4, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on August, 7. They expect $2.19 EPS, up 31.14 % or $0.52 from last year’s $1.67 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $10.76B for 21.90 P/E if the $2.19 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.73 actual EPS reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -19.78 % negative EPS growth.

Apple Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players to consumers, small and mid-sized businesses, and education, enterprise, and government clients worldwide. The company has market cap of $942.87 billion. The firm also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. It has a 18.55 P/E ratio. It offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers.
